title: Threshold
survival_class: Safe / Secure / Unconfirmed Entities (no numeric class)
physical_identity: Yellow office-like maze: sickly yellow wallpaper, damp seamless Berber-style carpet, buzzing fluorescent lights. Nicknamed 'The Yellow Hell'.
scale_topology: Infinite indoor labyrinth of rooms, hallways and stairs; layout shifts when unobserved.
lighting_sound: Buzzing fluorescent lights with random loud spikes; blackout zones are unlit and silent; whispers, voices, scratching behind walls.

entities.name: dark figures
entities.behavior: claimed to stalk between corridors; unconfirmed

entity_policy: NO CONFIRMED ENTITY PER SOURCE (existence unknown; only reported dark figures and unexplained sounds)
items_communities: carpet fluids incl. Liquid Pain and formalin
Base Alpha only mentioned as destination of survivors

entrances.quote: Falling out of reality is the most frequent way of entering Level 0

exits.method: throw yourself through a flickering wall
exits.conditions: survive long enough to find one
exits.quote: find a flickering wall to throw yourself through
none have reported doing so and surviving

signature_mechanic: Peripheral Shift: unobserved layout warps or rearranges, erasing mapped progress; stable arch zones; Isolation Effect with no companions.
verticality: None beyond stairs; holes are downward kill volumes.
conflicts_notes: Survival class given as three bullets, no number. Manila Room link is only on 'small room' text; destination not described. Testimony quotes are unreliable.

key_quotes.quote: Whenever not directly observed, the layout of the level can warp, stretch, or rearrange itself
they will never be able to find one another
completely unbreachable once fully entered—like a closed loop
find a flickering wall to throw yourself through
It is unknown whether or not entities exist in Level 0.
